question.text: The Compliance Officer must provide an Independent Report to SEBI on any non-compliance by the AIF:

answer.text: At the end of the financial year
Within 7 working days from observing such non-compliance

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 130, the Compliance Officer must provide an Independent Report to SEBI immediately or within 7 working days from observing such non-compliance. The Trap: Year-end reporting or reactive-only reporting on SEBI's request is not permitted. Note: The phrase "immediately or within 7 working days from observing non-compliance" is the controlling source language on page 130.
